54/S0.subgoal: Introduce the lecture topic and define the dual objectives of optimizing VR resource requirements: minimizing resources while maximizing experience.

54/S1.subgoal: Describe the various categories of resources (hardware, software, infrastructure) that influence VR system optimization.

54/S2.subgoal: Explain the reasons why resource optimization efforts must focus specifically on hardware requirements at the client end.

54/S3.subgoal: Explain the fundamental reason why computer graphics demands specialized hardware in the context of creating immersive VR experiences.

54/S4.subgoal: Define computer graphics, identifying the basic components of an image and the challenge of representing reality using binary data.

54/S5.subgoal: Identify the basic challenges in computer graphics, including how objects are represented and how imagery is synthesized onto a screen.

54/S6.subgoal: Outline the major conceptual components (host computer, display, controllers, memory) of a generic graphics system.

54/S7.subgoal: Describe how the display controller and GPU handle rendering tasks by performing computations separately from the main CPU.

54/S8.subgoal: Explain the function of video memory in storing the digital representation (zeros and ones) of the image being generated.

54/S9.subgoal: Describe how the video controller uses pixel excitation to convert stored digital data into a visible colored image.

54/S10.subgoal: Compare vector scan and raster scan rendering devices based on their approach to activating pixels.

54/S11.subgoal: Describe the raster scan process, illustrating how all pixels are considered sequentially to render an image.

54/S12.subgoal: Define the frame buffer and explain its relationship to the total screen resolution in a raster scan system.

54/S13.subgoal: Explain the concept of screen refreshing and the necessity of a high refresh rate for a quality virtual reality experience.

54/S14.subgoal: Explain how the human eye perceives color through the mixing of primary colors (Red, Green, and Blue).

54/S15.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts discussed regarding VR resource optimization and introduce the topic of the 3D graphics pipeline.
